body:
## Summary

Audit of all 104 `crates/*/src/**/*.rs` files (+ `xtask/src/main.rs`) against ADR-0001 §4. **File-length gate passes** (max 289). **`unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`/`todo!`/`dbg!`/print/`process::exit` are absent from production code** — every hit is inside a `#[cfg(test)]` module or a `tests/` crate. `unsafe`/`Rc`/`RefCell`/`LinkedList`/`transmute`/`mem::forget`/`Box::leak` are **clean**. All four `as` casts carry `#[expect(..., reason)]`; all `#[allow]` carry `reason`.

Real findings: (a) **`arithmetic_side_effects` is not enabled anywhere**, although ADR §4 mandates checked/saturating arithmetic and `clippy.toml:72-74` pre-configures its exemptions — raw integer arithmetic is therefore unlinted, including an `i32` glyph-advance `sum()` in `text.rs` that can panic with `overflow-checks = true` in release; (b) production **string slicing** at `commands/init.rs:128-129` (with a raw `end + len`) escapes the `indexing_slicing` gate because `string_slice` is not enabled; (c) `clippy.toml:15,17,24` grant `unwrap`/`expect`/indexing exemptions "in tests", contradicting the ADR's "não há 'isso é só um teste'"; (d) assorted clone-heavy and collect-only-to-check-emptiness idioms.

## Files

- `Cargo.toml:42-47,50-120` — profiles (`overflow-checks` in dev+release) and `[workspace.lints]`; the arithmetic lint is missing from the restriction block.
- `clippy.toml:14-24,71-74` — test exemptions and arithmetic-side-effects allow-list.
- `scripts/check_file_length.sh:8-17` — gate scope (`find crates -path '*/src/*'`).
- `Makefile:10-25` — `check` = fmt + clippy(all-targets) + test + file-length.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:61-83,209-213` — shaping + `i32` `sum()`; `to_px` i16 clamp.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/error.rs` — `ErrorKind`/`Error`, no `source()`.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/adapters.rs:38-44,55-65` — io/UTF-8 errors collapsed to strings.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/init.rs:119-136` — string slicing + raw byte arithmetic.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/{grid.rs:20-21,radial.rs:38-39,67,130-131,145,tree.rs:43,46,66,107,finish.rs:68}` — integer arithmetic and index loops.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/{raster.rs:100,126,excalidraw/support.rs:32-33,102-146,edges.rs:76-81,shapes.rs:44-58}` — arithmetic, casts, magic literals.
- `crates/akribie-mcp/src/tools.rs:77`, `tools/run.rs:141-149` — stringly `Err`, cast.

## Architecture

`akribie-core` is pure (no `std::fs|env|process`, verified by grep); all I/O crosses `ports::{Fs,Git,Env,Logger}` implemented only in `akribie-cli/src/adapters.rs`. `akribie-cli` maps `commands::*::execute -> Result` to `Envelope`/exit codes in `app.rs`/`envelope.rs`; `akribie-mcp` reuses core and encodes failures as JSON-RPC results. Quality gates live in `[workspace.lints]` + `clippy.toml` + `scripts/check_file_length.sh`, run by `make check`; `xtask` is workspace-excluded and outside every gate.

## Report

### 1. File length (≤300) — CLEAN

All 104 files under `crates/*/src/` measured individually; maximum is 289. Largest: `model/enums.rs` 289, `lex.rs` 283, `layout/finish.rs` 279, `sketch/shapes.rs` 279, `import/excalidraw/collect.rs` 277, `paint/mod.rs` 269, `config.rs` 266, `diff/mod.rs` 256, `commands/render/batch.rs` 242, `emit/svg.rs` 238.

Note: `xtask/src/main.rs` is 286 lines but is excluded from `scripts/check_file_length.sh:16` (`find crates ...`) and from `cargo clippy --workspace` — i.e. ungated, though under 300.

### 2. `unwrap/expect/panic!/todo!/unimplemented!/dbg!/print/process::exit/indexing/as` — production CLEAN, except indexing below

- Production `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`/`todo!`/`unimplemented!`/`unreachable!`/`dbg!`: **none**. `clippy.toml` (84-96 lints) plus manual grep confirm.
- All `expect` hits are test-only: `config.rs:206,209,221,252,254,261,263` (inside `mod tests` opened at `config.rs:179`); `pipeline.rs:109` (`#[cfg(test)]` at 102); `emit/raster.rs:137,138,153,154,158` (tests at 129); `layout/fit_tests.rs:77,100` (module declared `#[cfg(test)]` at `layout/mod.rs:8-9`); every `*_tests.rs`/`tests.rs`; `cli/tests/**`.
- `println!`/`print!`/`eprintln!`/`process::exit`: none in `crates/*/src`; CLI writes via `Write` (`cli/output.rs:11-40`, `mcp/main.rs:18-31`) and returns `ExitCode` (`cli/main.rs:20-33`). `eprintln!` only in the excluded build tool (`xtask/src/main.rs:107-165`).
- **Indexing (production violation of ADR §4 intent/gate gap):** `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/init.rs:128` `&current[..start]` and `:129` `&current[end + BLOCK_END.len()..]` — string range slicing in production. `indexing_slicing = "deny"` (`Cargo.toml:95`) does not fire on `str` slicing; that case is covered by `clippy::string_slice`, which is **not enabled**.
- Other `[i]` / `[a..b]` hits are test-only: `geometry.rs:236,238`; `emit/raster.rs:144,145`; `emit/excalidraw/tests.rs:42,58`; `emit/scene_json/tests.rs:34-38`; `layout/tests.rs:43,44,53,76`; `layout/fit_tests.rs:15`; `paint/tests.rs:36`; `diff/tests.rs:35-37,46-47,66-67`; `cli/commands/init/tests.rs:54,68,79`.
- `as` casts — 4 total in production, all annotated with `#[expect(..., reason = ...)]`: `emit/raster.rs:126` (expect at 119-124), `import/excalidraw/collect.rs:159` (154-158), `layout/flow.rs:85` (79-82), `mcp/src/tools/run.rs:147` (142-145). Zero in `akribie-cli`.

### 3. `#[allow]` without `reason` — CLEAN

No `#[allow]` in any `src/`. Four file-level `#![allow(...)]`, all with `reason`: `cli/tests/common/mod.rs:3-8`, `core/tests/lex.rs:1-4`, `core/tests/parse.rs:1-4`, `mcp/tests/mcp.rs:3-6`. All four `#[expect]` blocks carry `reason`.

ADR inconsistency (not a lint failure): `clippy.toml:15` `allow-expect-in-tests = true`, `:17` `allow-unwrap-in-tests = true`, `:24` `allow-indexing-slicing-in-tests = true`, counter to ADR §4 "não há 'isso é só um teste'" (ADR:89-90).

### 4. `unsafe`, `mem::forget`, `transmute`, `Box::leak`, `Rc`, `RefCell`, `LinkedList` — CLEAN

Zero occurrences of any construct. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` at `core/src/lib.rs:17`, `cli/src/main.rs:6`, `mcp/src/main.rs:6`; no `unsafe` keyword anywhere (word-boundary grep).

### 5. Arithmetic — findings (guard missing ⇒ raw integer arithmetic is unlinted)

**Guard gap:** `arithmetic_side_effects` is absent from `[workspace.lints.clippy]` (`Cargo.toml:72-120`) even though `clippy.toml:72-74` configures `arithmetic-side-effects-allowed = ["Wrapping","Saturating","f32","f64"]`. ADR §4 ("Aritmética com `checked_*`/`saturating_*`") therefore has no mechanical guard.

Raw integer arithmetic on untrusted/growing values:
- `core/src/text.rs:77-81` — `let units: i32 = ...map(|pos| pos.x_advance).sum();` over glyph advances of unbounded user label text; with `overflow-checks = true` in **release** (`Cargo.toml:43`) this panics/aborts on overflow. This is the only *panic-reaching* item.
- `core/src/layout/grid.rs:20-21` — `while columns * columns < count { columns += 1; }` raw `usize` mul/add.
- `core/src/emit/raster.rs:100` — `Vec::with_capacity(data.len() / 4 * 3)` raw `usize` operations.
- `core/src/emit/excalidraw/support.rs:32-33` — `rest % BASE62.len()` / `rest /= BASE62.len()`; positions ≥ 62⁴ silently alias (no panic, wrong `index`).
- `core/src/theme/contrast.rs:10-11` — `1 + index * 2`, `start + 2` raw before a `.get` (get prevents panic).
- `cli/src/commands/init.rs:129` — `end + BLOCK_END.len()` raw `usize` used as a slice bound.
- Unbounded raw counters: `core/src/resolve/edges.rs:40` `*ordinal += 1`; `core/src/diff/mod.rs:192` `*index += 1`; `core/src/layout/radial.rs:130` `cursor += 1`; `core/src/layout/tree.rs:72` `self.cursor += total + H_GAP` (f32).
- Silent saturation (doc/behavior mismatch): `core/src/text.rs:209-213` — doc says "sem saturação silenciosa", but `to_px` clamps `i32` font units to `i16` range, so widths of long unbreakable words saturate at 32767 units.

Explicitly exempt/by-design: all `f32`/`f64` arithmetic in `geometry.rs`, `num.rs`, `sketch/*`, `layout/finish.rs`, `layout/inset.rs`, `paint/*` is float-only (clippy.toml:72 lists `f32`/`f64` as allowed); `finish.rs` (279 lines) has no raw integer arithmetic beyond `for position in 0..count`.

### 6. Error handling vs. rust skill

Typed-Result coverage — good: `Config::from_toml/discover` (`config.rs:75,161`), `Font::load` (`text.rs:194`), `emit::encode` (`raster.rs:55`), `import` (`import/excalidraw.rs:34`), all `ports` methods → `core::Error`/`ErrorKind` (`error.rs:16-24`). Infallible stages are documented, not silently fallible: `parse` (`parse/mod.rs:32`), `resolve`, `layout`, `paint`, `svg`, `scene_json`, `excalidraw`. `lex` → `Result<_, Diagnostic>` (`lex.rs:41`) and `syntax::validate` → `Result<_, ValueError>` (`syntax/value.rs:79`) are typed, not stringly.

Stringly / loosened spots:
- `mcp/src/tools.rs:77` — `pub(crate) fn call(...) -> Result<Value, String>` (stringly error).
- `core/src/pipeline.rs:174` — `pub error: Option<String>` per batch line; mirrored as `ItemError { code: &'static str, message: String }` (`cli/src/batch.rs:13-19`).
- `cli/src/adapters.rs:38-44` collapses `std::io::Error` into `Error::io(format!(...))`; `Error` implements no `source()` (`error.rs:172`); UTF-8 error discarded at `adapters.rs:65`.
- `core/src/import/excalidraw.rs:56` — `let (document, _) = parse(...)` discards parse diagnostics.

Magic numbers (sibling code uses named consts, so these are gaps): `emit/excalidraw/edges.rs:76-81` (`0.55`, `1.25`, `20.0`), `excalidraw/shapes.rs:44-47,53` (`8.0`, `4.0`, `16.0`, `0.2`, `fontsize 16.0`), `excalidraw/support.rs:102-146` (`0.9`, `1.25`, `0.0001`, `0.5001`), `sketch/cloud.rs:20-21` (`20.0`, `0.9`), `layout/inset.rs:57-58,63` (`0.5`, `0.75`, loop bound `4`), `paint/edge.rs:84` (`128.0`, `0.001`), `text.rs:75` (`0.5` fallback), `mcp/src/tools/run.rs:40-44` (literal `0` errors). Counter-examples of correct style: `text.rs:20-32`, `layout/grid.rs:6-8`, `layout/inset.rs:11-14`.

### 7. Iterator idioms — findings

Index loops (`for i in 0..len`-style):
- `core/src/layout/finish.rs:68` — `for position in 0..count` (count = `chart.groups.len()`).
- `core/src/layout/radial.rs:145` — `for position in 0..count`.
- `core/src/layout/tree.rs:46` and `:107` — `for index in 0..count`.
- `core/src/sketch/cloud.rs:46` — `for index in 0..count` with `% count`.
- (test) `core/src/layout/fit_tests.rs:14`.

Needless `collect`:
- `core/src/emit/svg.rs:81` — collects the section iterator into `Vec<String>` only to test `is_empty()` (extra allocation per section).
- `core/src/lex.rs:216` — `chars: line.chars().collect::<Vec<char>>()` allocates a `Vec<char>` per line solely to use `.get(at)`; `CharIndices` avoids it.
- Acceptable: `a11y.rs:17`/`fmt.rs:77`/`diff/mod.rs:145`/`scene_json.rs:27-30,70` (join/sort/json need the container).

Clone-heavy:
- `core/src/layout/tree.rs:43` — `for root in roots.clone()` clones the vector just to iterate (`iter().copied()`).
- `core/src/layout/tree.rs:66`, `radial.rs:39`, `radial.rs:67`, `radial.rs:131` — `.get(i).cloned().unwrap_or_default()` clones a whole `Vec<usize>` (heap allocation) per visited node; `map_or(&[][..], Vec::as_slice)` avoids it.
- `core/src/diff/mod.rs:189-190` — `note.near.clone().unwrap_or_default()` then `seen.entry(anchor.clone())`; two allocations of the same string.
- `core/src/resolve/mod.rs:140-142` — `stmt.label.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| stmt.id.clone())` plus `declared_label: stmt.label.clone()` (up to 3 clones of one `Option<String>`).
- Owned-field clones in `finish.rs:30,78,80,209-213`, `paint/{edge.rs:40,group.rs:20,49,mod.rs:243}` are structurally required (`Placed*`/`TextRun` own `String`).

### Critical Files for Implementation

- `Cargo.toml` — add `arithmetic_side_effects`/`string_slice` to `[workspace.lints.clippy]` (the guard gap behind §5/§7 findings).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs` — `i32` glyph-advance `sum()` (77-81) and the saturating `to_px` clamp (209-213).
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/init.rs` — production string slicing + raw byte arithmetic (128-129) escaping the indexing gate.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/tree.rs` — `roots.clone()` and per-node `children…cloned()` (43, 66) plus index loops (46, 107).
- `clippy.toml` — test exemptions (15, 17, 24) that contradict ADR §4's "não há 'isso é só um teste'".
